fridayReminder.title: Friday Jumu'ah Wazifa Reminder
fridayReminder.description: Special wazaif prescribed for Friday: Al-Basir (100x between Farz & Sunnah for esteem) & Al-Awwal (1,000x for 40 Fridays).

fajrReminder.title: Daily Post-Fajr Wazifa Reminder
fajrReminder.description: Recite Ya-Rahim 100 times after Fajr prayer for peace, ease, and friendly relations with all.

thursdayZuhrReminder.title: Thursday Post-Zuhr Wazifa Reminder
thursdayZuhrReminder.description: Recite Ya-Sami 100 times in silence after Zuhr on Thursdays for fulfillment of your desires.
